_comment: High or critical advisories accepted in development-only tooling (never in the shipped package). Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails CI again. Runtime dependencies have no exceptions (npm audit --omit=dev must be clean). See D-046.

exceptions.via: vitest (dev only: vitest -> vite, tinyglobby, fdir -> picomatch)
exceptions.reason: ReDoS through crafted extglob patterns. Every published picomatch version is affected (no fixed release on 2026-11-17). Here picomatch only matches test-file globs written in this repository's own vitest configuration; no untrusted pattern reaches it, and it is not in the published bundle (dist/ contains no picomatch).
